meta.name: Live Caption MVP Project Dashboard
meta.subtitle: Project command center for the Ava-like captioning MVP: roadmap, delivery health, task board, risks, and next actions.
meta.currentMilestone: Stage 4: Friendly errors and startup checks

targets.name: Stable live-caption MVP
targets.metric: Live captions, persistent transcript, Chrome microphone flow, safe API key handling

targets.name: Translation and export polish
targets.metric: Spanish, French, and German tested; copy, TXT, and JSON exports include translations

targets.name: Local session saving MVP
targets.metric: Saved sessions panel works with save, open, delete, and refresh persistence

targets.name: Manual QA checklist
targets.metric: QA_CHECKLIST.md added and README links to it

targets.name: Friendly error handling
targets.metric: Clear messages for port conflict, missing/invalid key, quota, and microphone issues

targets.name: Private beta readiness
targets.metric: Stable sessions, exports, instructions, QA checklist, and basic UX polish

annotations.title: Project bootstrapped
annotations.body: Local app, GitHub repo, Codex workflow, and README setup completed.

annotations.title: Realtime transcription fixed
annotations.body: Changed Realtime URL/session shape and omitted unsupported VAD for gpt-realtime-whisper.

annotations.title: Translation MVP confirmed
annotations.body: Spanish, French, and German translations work for completed transcript entries.

annotations.title: Exports confirmed
annotations.body: Copy transcript, TXT download, and JSON download include original text and translations clearly.

annotations.title: Local session saving confirmed
annotations.body: Saved sessions work with text-only transcript storage, open, delete, and persistence after page refresh. Audio is intentionally not stored yet.

annotations.title: Manual QA checklist added
annotations.body: QA_CHECKLIST.md now covers startup, mic access, captions, translations, exports, saved sessions, and common errors. README links to it.

pipeline.title: Friendly errors and startup checks
pipeline.description: Improve messages for missing API key, invalid key, quota errors, port conflicts, and browser microphone problems.

pipeline.title: Run full QA checklist
pipeline.description: Use QA_CHECKLIST.md top to bottom after friendly error changes land.

pipeline.title: Product UX polish
pipeline.description: Make the caption app easier to scan before sharing with testers.

pipeline.title: Desktop overlay
pipeline.description: Build a floating caption bar for meetings and videos after the web app is stable.

pipeline.title: Private beta
pipeline.description: Share with a few users, collect feedback, and decide the product direction.

risks.risk: Session data only lives in the browser for now
risks.mitigation: Keep export buttons and clearly document that localStorage is local-only.
Only one Codex task at a time; do not start database, login, or desktop overlay yet.
Keep translation on final transcripts only and watch OpenAI billing.
Use Chrome as the primary test browser before Safari/Edge.
Prioritize readability, large fonts, keyboard access, and real user feedback.

tasks.Why it matters: Proves the project can run on your Mac before adding features.
tasks.Done means: localhost:5174 opens and shows the caption UI.
tasks.Next action: Keep using Chrome for primary tests.

tasks.Why it matters: Captions could not work until the websocket opened correctly.
tasks.Done means: OpenAI websocket opens and accepts streamed PCM audio.
tasks.Next action: Do not touch working transcription path unless necessary.

tasks.Why it matters: This is the main product proof point.
tasks.Done means: Spoken English appears as live captions.
tasks.Next action: Use this as the regression test after every change.

tasks.Why it matters: Users must not lose captions when a session ends.
tasks.Done means: Transcript entries remain visible after Stop.
tasks.Next action: Keep transcript state stable while adding future features.

tasks.Task: Add translation dropdown and completed-transcript translation
tasks.Why it matters: Moves the MVP from captions only to multilingual usefulness.
tasks.Done means: Spanish, French, and German translations appear under transcript entries.
tasks.Next action: Keep translation on final transcripts only for now.

tasks.Task: Include translations in Copy, TXT, and JSON exports
tasks.Why it matters: Exports are only useful if they preserve the translated text.
tasks.Done means: Copy, TXT, and JSON all include original text and translations clearly.
tasks.Next action: Use exports as part of each manual QA pass.

tasks.Task: Verify Spanish, French, and German translation output
tasks.Why it matters: Confirms translation works beyond one language.
tasks.Done means: All three languages tested with visible translation output.
tasks.Next action: Add more language QA later, not now.

tasks.Task: Add local session history using browser localStorage
tasks.Why it matters: Users need to reopen previous caption sessions without relying only on downloads.
tasks.Done means: Stopping a session saves it locally with transcript and translations.
tasks.Next action: Document that audio is not stored yet.

tasks.Why it matters: Users need a visible way to find previous sessions.
tasks.Done means: Panel lists sessions with date, utterance count, and translation target.
tasks.Next action: Keep saved sessions visible and simple.

tasks.Why it matters: Saved sessions are not useful unless users can restore and manage them.
tasks.Done means: User can open a saved session into the transcript panel and delete sessions after confirmation.
tasks.Next action: Use as part of regression QA.

tasks.Why it matters: localStorage must persist after page refresh and server restart.
tasks.Done means: Saved sessions remain after refresh, can be opened, and can be deleted.
tasks.Next action: Repeat before any private beta demo.

tasks.Why it matters: Future you needs clear instructions for how local session history works.
tasks.Done means: README explains localStorage, export backups, and delete behavior.
tasks.Next action: Keep README updated after future storage changes.

tasks.Why it matters: Every new feature should be tested without breaking captions.
tasks.Done means: Checklist covers captioning, translation, exports, sessions, errors, and browser refresh.
tasks.Next action: Use QA_CHECKLIST.md after any code change.
tasks.Notes: QA_CHECKLIST.md added; README links to it.

tasks.Task: Improve friendly startup and error messages
tasks.Why it matters: Beginners need obvious guidance when ports, API keys, or quota fail.
tasks.Done means: Common errors have clear UI messages and safe logs.
tasks.Next action: Ask Codex to improve friendly error messages next.

tasks.Why it matters: The app should feel clean enough to show to a tester.
tasks.Done means: Controls, transcript, saved sessions, and exports are easier to scan.

tasks.Why it matters: This is closer to the Ava-like experience for meetings.
tasks.Done means: A floating caption window prototype works locally.
tasks.Next action: Do not start until the web MVP is stable.
